_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Hye-jin Park
about_me: I'm Hye-jin, a Ross BBA junior who did a product internship at a fintech. I want a summer 2027 PM internship at an EV company. I can help with market research and user interviews.
goals: Land a summer 2027 PM internship at an EV company

debriefs.text: Met Nate Okonkwo, a PM at Rivian in Plymouth on charging software. He said they hire PM interns in January and he'd refer me if I do a product teardown.
Grace Adeyemi from the Venture Club said EV startups hire PMs through investors, and suggested I talk to Theo Vance at Huron Ventures.
Coffee with Liam O'Connor, a Ford software engineer building an EV charging-map side project. He wants a PM to help with user interviews.
Lucia Ferraro, Ford recruiter, said Ford Pro has a PM rotational program for new grads, not interns.
